AD_COLUMN.HELP: There are two methods of making records unavailable in the system: One is to delete the record, the other is to de-activate the record. AD_COLUMN.HELP:
A search key allows for a fast method of finding a particular record. If you leave the search key empty, the system automatically creates a numeric number originating from a document sequence defined in the "Document Sequence" window. The sequence naming convention follows a rule "DocumentNo_TableName", where TableName is the actual name of the database table (e.g. C_Order).
Usually, company's internal identifiers for various records (products, customers, etc) are stored here.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Filter
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Logical expression used to evaluate incoming events captured through Kafka.
AD_COLUMN.HELP:
This field defines a dynamic filter expression used to evaluate incoming events captured through Kafka. If a value is provided in this field, only those events for which the expression evaluates to true will be processed; all others will be ignored.
The expression must follow Openbravo’s DynamicExpressionParser syntax. You can reference event payload fields using @fieldName@ notation. Context variables such as @#AD_Client_ID@ may also be used if available.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Event Jsoninfo
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Stores the full JSON payload that triggered the automatic task, or user-supplied parameter JSON for tasks created manually (Created Automatically = N), enabling complete workflow audit.
AD_COLUMN.HELP:
This field keeps a JSON document related to the task’s origin: -Automatic tasks – the Debezium/Kafka event (before, after, op, source, …) that matched the Task Type rule. -Manual tasks – any parameter JSON entered by the user or UI when Created Automatically = N.
Use it to: -Inspect the exact data change or parameters that launched the workflow. -Debug filter or advanced-logic conditions. -Reproduce the context when re-processing tasks.
The value is set on task creation and is rarely modified afterwards. Stored as plain text (JSON format); copy it to an external viewer for easier reading.
